notes.title: Deluge - Remake Announcement!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for checking out my 2021 game DELUGE, made in RPG Maker 2003. If you haven't noticed, I've recently updated the page to change the name, to "DELUGE 2003". For some it might have been a random decision, but today I get to formally explain why! [/p][p]Over a year and a half ago, I took on the idea of rebuilding DELUGE as a new game. I had recently been developing a title, tentatively called "GENTLE", and using a later RPG Maker engine to do so. Another developer friend, UPRC, had recreated a handful of DELUGE maps in his fangame, so I used them as a foundation and began to build. Having learned a ton of new game development tips and tricks, this rebuild soon began to expand and I started to have way too much fun with it. [/p][p]Before I knew it, I had dumped the entire story, maps and scenes from the original version of the game into RPG Maker MZ[b]—[/b]combat aside. I had a feeling I'd want to try something different for that part, so I held off and created a few concepts. The game took shape from there.[/p][p]Fast forward to gaining the combat and overworld programming support of my good friend Gimmer, a functional and stylish menu designed by another great friend, Narcodis, as well as pixel art by BD Bandkanon (also friend and good), and the combat system came alive![/p][p]Anyway, all of that to say... I ended up redoing a ton of scenes. Then we got accepted to feature at TooManyGames, a massive game convention right outside of Philadelphia, this year.[/p][p]Before I knew it, the new game took on a personality of its own:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41517212/22ad3978b7b3641e6823652d20fa1a172b69c377.png"][/img]And now that the Steam page is launched, I'm proud to present the latest and greatest edition of Deluge![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3779440/Deluge/" style="button"]Check out Deluge on Steam[/url][/p][p][b]Listen to the game and TooManyGames announcement here:[/b][/p][previewyoutube="D5hDoKBF3fM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Thanks for watching, following, supporting, and (most importantly) playing.[/p][p]Appreciate you![/p]

notes.title: Deluge PHYSICAL COPIES are now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Riggy here. ːScoutSheepː

I'm doing a short run of physical CD-ROM copies of DELUGE in order to fundraise for my current project, GENTLE! You can now own a shrink-wrapped, physical copy of my skeleton game, and every order entered before the end of day, June5,  will have their name or username included inside the booklet!

I've been having a blast revisiting the game to create the perfect traditional CD-ROM edition of the game, and have been updating the game one last time to make it even more robust and functional, which you'll be able to experience on the disc and via Steam/Itch if you already own the game, so stay tuned for that!

All proceeds from this disc will go to helping me fund and develop my latest project, GENTLE! I've been working with programmers, artists and more on this one and can't wait to start sharing more information on it.

[url=https://riggy2k3-shop.fourthwall.com/products/deluge-cd-rom]CLICK HERE[/url] to grab yourself one!

Thank you everyone for your support! It means the world to me!!!!

Riggy2k3

notes.title: One year of DELUGE! - 50% off + V.1.6.2 out now!
notes.notes:
Here's a bunch of news and updates to the game. We're almost a year into the game being out and that's very exciting to me. Thank you! :)

[b]I HAVE FIXED MORE BUGS[/b]
First thing's first... there's a new, minor update to the game. I started to see this error pop up in a couple of new playthroughs, so I had to jump at it and fix quickly! When you would leave an unlocked area (after the 'chest room') the game would crash and identify "Invalid Map Event ID: 69" which, while a funny error, this was breaking the game, so it had to go!

[b]v.1.6.2[/b] - Thanks for sticking with me through the development cycle! :)
- Fixed a funny bug: "Invalid Map Event ID: 69" :)
- Fixed a couple of mapping inconsistencies
- Minor updates to dialog speed/expressions
- Minor graphic updates

Thank you to everyone who pointed the errors they saw out to me and for sticking through the game despite it!

[b]DELUGE IS FEATURED ON RPGMAKER.NET FOR OCTOBER[/b]
I'm really grateful to RPGMaker.net for choosing DELUGE as the featured game for the month of October on their website. I've been a fan of this site and a member of its community since its inception and it means a lot to be supported by such an awesome community. Many other RPG Maker 2003 developers (and beyond) have become genuine friends, and for that I am grateful. Thanks guys!

[b]DELUGE IS DISCOUNTED ON STEAM[/b]
Furthermore, starting today, the game will be available on Steam for a short time for 50% off! That's a nice, spooky horror RPG for the season for only $1 USD! The sale lasts for a short time only, so if you haven't picked up the game yet, I hope you'll consider doing so!

[b]DELUGE IS ABOUT TO BE A YEAR OLD![/b]
I'm working on a short piece to honor and celebrate a year of DELUGE on Halloween, October 31, but until then....

See ya!
